name: Frame Perf Overlay
note: fps, CPU/GPU, temperatures and battery in the SteamVR dashboard

name: Frame Mic Tuner
note: Switch the mic's echo cancellation and noise suppression from the dashboard

name: Frame Color
note: Adjust the display's colours from the dashboard (restarts SteamVR)

name: OpenMW-VR
note: Morrowind in VR on the headset; needs Morrowind installed from Steam

name: Moonlight XR for Frame
note: Stream games from your PC (Sunshine/Apollo) to a 3D screen in the headset

name: KartFrame (Mario Kart Wii VR)
note: Native port of Wiicompiled VR PLUS; built from your own disc on first run

name: GalaxyFrame (Super Mario Galaxy VR)
note: Native port of GalaxyQuest; needs your own disc

name: PrimedFrame (Metroid Prime VR)
note: Native port of PrimedGun; needs your own disc image

note: OpenH1 with Frame controls and defaults; needs your own Xbox maps

name: LegendFrame (Tomb Raider: Legend VR)
note: TRLVR with single-pass stereo, under Proton; needs the Steam game
